basic_info.description: Fabulous opportunity to own a four bedroom, two bath, freshly updated home that has been lovingly maintained by one owner since being newly constructed in 1955 and positioned in a prime Portola district location!  Behind the tasteful Mid-century facade is an inviting covered tunnel entrance that leads to the main door.  The home opens to a formal living room with a fireplace, a large and open kitchen/ding area, a full bathroom, and three spacious bedrooms all on one level and graced with plenty of natural light. The lower level of the home has an additional bedroom, bathroom, and laundry area with direct access to the backyard/garden/patio.  The garage has interior access, presents the potential for future expansion, and offers ample space for storage.  The low maintenance backyard/garden/patio offers a blank canvas for the new owner to create their own outdoor space, whether it be for entertainment, gardening, or peaceful repose.  Do not miss this special home that is close to shopping, restaurants, cafes, playgrounds, McLaren Park, HWY 101/280 and more!
